classes.name: results
classes.reason: write_staged explicitly calls os.fsync before os.close, so the rank issuing it stops and waits for the write to become durable before moving to the next task; other ranks are not waiting because only a per-generation barrier.wait() synchronizes them, not each file access.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: write_buffered only calls os.write/os.close with no os.fsync, so the data is left in the OS buffer cache and the rank continues immediately, overlapping the I/O with the rest of the loop; other ranks proceed independently since the only synchronization point is the per-generation barrier.wait(), not each file access.
